description: Rates for one model of any kind. Token rates are USD per million tokens: input (in), output (out), cache read (cr), cache write (cw, cw1h) and audio (ain, aout), with batch, priority and long-context tiers. Models billed per image, second, character, query or page have a unit rate (unit), and may have size, quality or resolution variants (v:...).
